en-US.promotionalText: Explore all 81 chapters through illustrated stories, gentle humor and reflections in English and Chinese. Read slowly, ask Wendao AI, and share what resonates.
en-US.whatsNew: Tao in Everyday Life now includes illustrated stories for all 81 chapters, with English and Chinese images and matching comic reflections. Explore a different visual style in each chapter, zoom in, and share or save the complete image. This update also improves image sharing, refreshes the Buer Within link, and adds optional usage statistics in More. Statistics are off by default and can be turned off anytime; chat text and birth details are not included.
en-US.description:
A quiet way to read the Daodejing and reflect on everyday life.

TAO IN EVERYDAY LIFE
Explore illustrated stories for all 81 chapters, in both English and Chinese. Gentle humor, familiar situations and a different visual style for each chapter bring the text into daily life. Open section 04 after a chapter’s insights, enlarge the comic, and read a reflection that explains its story. Share or save the complete image with a reading link and QR code.

READ AT YOUR OWN PACE
Mawangdui Silk Manuscript B is the primary foundation. Silk B transcription, edited base text and modern interpretation remain distinct. Read tone-marked pinyin, line-by-line meaning, chapter themes and practical insights. Use full-text search, chance selection, continuous reading, day and night modes, and adjustable text size. Today’s recommended chapter is free; you can also choose 10 chapters to keep free without an account.

ASK WENDAO AI
Bring a real situation to the chapter you are reading. Wendao AI responds in plain, thoughtful language, with occasional quotations from the classic. It supports reflection without deciding for you. This is AI inspired by the Daodejing, not the historical Laozi. Sign in with Apple or Google for 3 free questions each UTC day. Active members can ask unlimited questions, subject to reasonable concurrency, rate and abuse safeguards.

Continue a conversation, revisit recent chats, and manage the memories used in future responses. Review, edit, pause or clear memory; use weekly reflection to notice recurring themes. On wider screens, read and talk side by side. An optional Life Manual offers another lens for self-observation, without treating your type as a fixed verdict.

MEMBERSHIP AND PERMANENT READING
Monthly or annual membership unlocks all 81 chapters plus Wendao AI, automatic memory and weekly reflection. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through your Apple account. Prices and renewal terms are shown before purchase. A separate one-time Unlock All Chapters Forever purchase unlocks reading permanently without renewal; AI services are not included. Restore purchases and manage your subscription in the app.

YOUR CHOICES
Optional usage statistics are off by default and can be changed in More. They help improve reading, sharing and AI reliability without collecting chat text or birth details in analytics. You can export your data, manage memories and delete your account in the app.

AI responses are for reflection, not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice. They do not replace your decisions.

Privacy: https://wendao.wonderelian.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

True to yourself. Flow with life.

zh-Hans.promotionalText: 81 章「生活里的道」中英文漫画，用有趣的故事读懂日常。慢读经典，与 AI 问道，把有所触动的一页分享出去。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
「生活里的道」现已补齐 81 章中英文漫画，每章采用不同的图片风格，并配有解读画面与故事的文字。可以放大阅读、分享或保存完整长图。
本次还改进了图片分享，更新「不二见己」入口，并在更多菜单加入可选使用统计。统计默认关闭，可随时停用，不包含对话正文和出生资料。
zh-Hans.description:
三慢问道，把《道德经》带回真实生活。

【生活里的道：81 章中英文漫画】
用轻松诙谐的故事，描绘我们熟悉的日常处境。81 章各有不同的图片风格，同时提供中文、英文漫画与对应解读。在每章「对我们的启发」之后进入 04「生活里的道」，点图放大，读懂故事，也看见自己。完整长图可以保存和分享，并附阅读链接与二维码。

【慢读经典】
以马王堆帛书乙本为主要依据，清楚区分帛书转写、校读正文与现代解读。提供带声调拼音、逐句今译、章节主题和贴近日常的启发。支持全文搜索、偶遇一章、连续阅读、日夜模式与字号调整。每日推荐章节免费阅读，还可以自行保留 10 章永久免费，无需账号。

【AI 问道】
把眼前真实的困惑，带回正在阅读的章节。用简静白话交流，偶尔引用原文，像向一位通透的长者请教。AI 借经典帮助观察与思考，不冒充历史上的老子，也不替你做决定。使用 Apple 或 Google 登录后，每个 UTC 自然日可免费对话 3 条；有效会员可不限次数对话，仍受合理的并发、速率与防滥用限制。

继续最近的对话，查看、编辑、暂停或清除自动记忆，通过每周回望发现反复出现的主题。宽屏下支持边读边问。可选的「人生说明书」提供自我观察的角度，不用一个类型规定你该成为谁。

【会员与永久阅读】
月会员或年会员解锁全部 81 章，以及 AI 问道、自动记忆和每周回望。订阅到期自动续费，除非通过 Apple 账户取消；购买前会清楚显示价格和续费条款。也可单独一次性购买「永久解锁全部章节」，永久获得阅读权限，无需续费，不包含 AI 服务。可在 App 内恢复购买、管理订阅。

【由你选择】
可选使用统计默认关闭，可在更多菜单随时调整。统计帮助改进阅读、分享与 AI 稳定性，不采集对话正文和出生资料。支持管理记忆、导出个人数据和删除账号。

AI 回答用于启发与自我观察，不构成医疗、心理、法律或财务建议，不替代你的判断。

隐私政策：https://wendao.wonderelian.com/privacy.html
使用条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

真实自己，流动人生。
